name: utf16_urls
description: String candidates for URLs, file: and Visited: entries and 192.168.x.x addresses in a file; not a browser parser. ascii: http:// or https:// and at least six URL characters, to the first byte that is not one, with no length cut off. utf16le: a run of at least eight UTF-16LE characters that contains http, file:, visited: or 192.168; a run begins at a printable ASCII character and goes on through printable ASCII, Latin-1 and the letters of Latin Extended, Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew, Arabic, Indic and Thai (so https://örnek.test/ is one candidate; CJK is not read, its code units are ASCII letter pairs); a NUL, a control character or a surrogate ends it. Every occurrence is kept with its byte offset and encoding (the same text twice is two candidates); a groups view lists each distinct text once with its count and first offset (bounded by max_distinct, and says when it stopped growing). The file is read in windows with a carry, never whole, so a match that straddles a window is found once; a run longer than the carry is returned in adjacent pieces (continued: true on all but the last) so no character is lost. A string does not say it was visited, typed, downloaded or opened, or by whom. SENSITIVE: a URL can carry a session token or a password in its query string, fragment or user-info; the text of every candidate is returned with those values replaced by a marker holding only their length, url_secrets_withheld says how many, of what kind and at which offset, and contains is matched against the text as returned. write_url_secrets: true writes the whole text to a 0600 file under $OUT, in a job run with secret_output: true only. A secret in a path or in free text is not found. An unreadable file is a JSON failure.

contains.description: Optional substring filter (case-insensitive) on the candidate text; the candidates it leaves out are counted under filtered_out_by_contains

limit.description: Candidates and groups shown inline, each (default 200, an inline page size); every one is kept, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results

chunk.description: Bytes read per window (default 8 MiB, from 131072 to 268435456)

max_distinct.description: Distinct texts the groups view tracks (default 100000); past it the view stops growing and groups_complete is false, while every occurrence is still a candidate

write_url_secrets.description: Write the whole text of every URL whose secrets were withheld, with the secret value, to a file under $OUT (mode 0600, created first, never replaced): only in a job run with secret_output: true, refused anywhere else; default false
